shouldFix.title: CELL-1 names P-1, P-2 and G3, and the artifact states a disposition for only two of the three — a mention v1 carried and v2 dropped
shouldFix.finding: The acceptance cell's first limb, which the artifact itself isolates as CELL-1, is 'Explicit successor to P-1/P-2/G3'. Measured across the whole artifact: P-2 is disposed in its own voice at item 3 ('P-2 narrow producers / data-only remains') and again at EE-3 ('Contributors remain P-2 narrow/data-only'); G3 is the subject of item 7, whose name carries it and whose disposition is an explicit PARTIAL. P-1 occurs exactly twice, and both occurrences are inside quotations of the cell — acceptanceEvidenceCellVerbatim and CELL-1's own fragment. The artifact never says, in its own voice, what the preview successor does to P-1. The substance is present: file 02 defines P-1 as 'no marketplace, public lifecycle parity, discovery service, or ecosystem governance depth', and items 1 and 2 dispose exactly marketplace/catalog/governance depth and external lifecycle parity/discovery, both NO. But the mapping is left for the reader to derive, in a cell whose adjective is 'Explicit'. This is also a regression: v1's authorityClaim read 'PROPOSES the preview-scoped successor to P-1/P-2/G3', and v2's reads 'PROPOSES the preview-scoped DR-117 successor candidate', dropping the three identifiers. The corpus's own comparable disposition states the conclusion rather than implying it — D-068 records of preview.v2 that 'P-1, P-2, and G3-SUBSTRATE are preserved.'

distanceToAccept.assessment: One clause. All four v1 findings are genuinely repaired and several beyond the minimum asked. The single remaining item is a mapping sentence, not new work, and it restores something the predecessor already had.
distanceToAccept.regressionNoted: The dropped P-1/P-2/G3 naming is a regression introduced by rewriting the authorityClaim. Successors should carry forward the identifiers they replace, the same lesson the provider-only chain learned when v2 dropped v1's D9/exit test class.

coordinatorSummary: REJECT at 0 blockers and 1 SHOULD-FIX, with 1 advisory. Seventeen attacks run, two landed, neither at blocker grade. Custody is intact: subject f3e91157 at 0444 unmoved and valid JSON, predecessor v1 frozen at 50cb8c71, HEAD never left d204ba0, file 08 and file 02 at their pins with a clean tree. All four v1 findings are repaired and I tested each against live sources rather than my own earlier text. My B1 is repaired thoroughly: a lineage block pins v8 and preview.v2 by path and digest with their recordings and continuing roles named, and I confirmed against v8's own bytes that its purpose really is to refuse silent succession from preview, that D-066 recorded preview.v2 at the cited digest, and that D-068 really does say it does not close DR-117; the v1 succession claim is downgraded to 'candidate' with explicit refusals of both replacement and conversion. My B2 is repaired: all seven item names now match file 02 exactly under programmatic extraction, where v1 had a truncation, and the enforcement half is routed to DR-128's post-MVP successor with an express refusal of the condition-4 label. Codex's blocker is repaired with a real enforcement-evidence limb: EE-1 through EE-7 cover every item, grounded in a pinned and verbatim-verified v1-slice §7 item 8, with owners I spot-checked against DR-123's, DR-119's and DR-133's live standings, and with 'Named remaining design ... Not silently called condition 4' wherever no harness exists. Codex's SHOULD-FIX is repaired with the host-act versus contribution-role distinction and the apt D-032 citation. What remains is one clause. The cell's first limb, which the artifact itself isolates as CELL-1, is 'Explicit successor to P-1/P-2/G3'. P-2 is disposed in the artifact's own voice at item 3 and EE-3, G3 is the subject of item 7, and P-1 occurs exactly twice — both times inside quotations of the cell. Its content is fully covered by items 1 and 2, but the mapping is never stated, and v1's authorityClaim had named all three where v2's does not. D-068's comparable recording states the conclusion outright: 'P-1, P-2, and G3-SUBSTRATE are preserved.' One mapping sentence closes it. The advisory is that preview.v2 is called the owner recording where DR-010's cell makes D-068 the recording and preview.v2 the effective disposition. A v3 carrying that clause should ACCEPT.
